@Alex2782 I believe the tests run only as long as your test logic. When that logic ends, the test is complete and the app is shutdown.
If you want it to display for longer, then you need to keep the test logic running either by sleeping or blocking waiting on a condition.

> I believe the tests run only as long as your test logic Yes, that's correct. However, in my test app (3D scene + Animation, see `details`) I don't have any cancel logic; the tests should run for at least 1 minute (Firebase Test Lab configuration).

> Actually, it seems that `github.event_name` only registers the event of the *current* file. That is, it would always return `workflow_call`. I'll make a PR later today to pass the runner's metadata to circumvent this

Turns out I was dead-wrong about this or was thinking of something else entirely, as it DOES detect the caller's workflow after all. In that case, the conditionals could be changed to:
```diff
-        if: matrix.target == 'template_debug' && github.event_name == 'merge_group'
+        if: matrix.target == 'template_debug' && github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref_name == github.event.repository.default_branch
```
This would only run the tests when the default branch is pushed to (aka: whenever a merge batch is uploaded), which should be infrequent enough for your needs
